MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_PEN.title: Hiro's Pen
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_PEN.description: At the start of each combat, gain 3 stacks of [color=#CC6666]【Justice】[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_PEN.flavor: A pen [color=#CC6666]Hiro[/color] often used in middle school. It should have been given to Yuki.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCH_FACTOR.title: Witch Factor
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCH_FACTOR.descript: When you play an Attack card, gain 15 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b]. When you play a Skill or Power card, lose 10 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b] (Cards may sometimes be played automatically).
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCH_FACTOR.flavor: When the Witch Factor is overactive, one loses their sanity and becomes a monster-like existence, regarded as a dangerous entity that must be eliminated.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHHIRO.title: Object Once Possessed by the Great Witch
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHHIRO.description:
[color=#CC6666]"Yuki... you are mistaken."[/color]
At the start of each combat, gain 6 stacks of [color=#CC6666]【Justice】[/color].
At the start of turn, you may choose a card in your hand to return to your draw pile.
The first time you gain [b]【Suspect】[/b] in each combat, reduce it by 2 stacks.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHHIRO.flavor:
[color=#CC6666]"But... I still want to find [/color][color=#CCCCCC]you[/color][color=#CC6666]."[/color]
[color=#CC6666]"I'm coming to find you now—to judge our [/color][b]【Sins】[/b][color=#CC6666]."[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.title: Witch Data
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.descrip: Upon acquisition, randomly generate 13 cards from the reserve Witch cards. Choose any number to add to your deck.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.flavor: Extensive data detailing material transactions between the island and the mansion, as well as information on the detained girls. It also contains profiles and facial photos of Ema and everyone else. Deciphering it seems to require a great deal of time.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.selecti: Choose cards to add to your deck
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_DISMANTLEDPARTS.title: Dismantled Parts
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_DISMANTLEDPARTS.descr: Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} each turn. On the first turn, automatically play all Attack cards against random enemy targets.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_DISMANTLEDPARTS.flavo: Parts of a crossbow stored in a barrel in the corridor. Dismantled into such tiny pieces that repair is difficult.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGICSNIPERRIFLE.desc: Gain 1 Ammo upon entering each node (Max 6). Right-click to consume 1 Ammo and add a [b]【Bullet】[/b] to your hand.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGICSNIPERRIFLE.flav: Maximum capacity of 6 rounds. A weapon crafted with magic by a girl who once existed within the prison. Automatically loads 1 round when the date changes.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_BLOODIEDCLOTHING.desc: Lose 26 [b]Max HP[/b]. All Skill cards in your deck gain the [b]【Clever】[/b] enchantment.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_FRUITPLATE.title: Fruit Platter from Memory
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_FRUITPLATE.descriptio: Upon acquisition, choose 1 card in your deck to enchant with [color=#ff99cc][b]【Ema's Apple】[/b][/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_FRUITPLATE.flavor: A fruit platter Ema brought over on an afternoon long ago.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_FRUITPLATE.selectionS: Choose 1 card to enchant with [color=#ff99cc][b]【Ema's Apple】[/b][/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_SAFE.title: Safe
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_SAFE.description: Upon acquisition, obtain 2 random Ancient Relics.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_SAFE.flavor:
A safe that has been opened.
It has a digital keypad lock, stained with blood near the keypad.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGICALSKETCHBOOK.des: At the start of each combat, gain 3 stacks of [b]【Crimson Butterfly】[/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGICALSKETCHBOOK.fla:
Natsume An'an's sketchbook.
Contains drawings of butterflies.
The artist of the drawings is Noah, and the butterflies seem to be a form of protection left for An'an.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MLLNOTE.title: Note
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MLLNOTE.description: Upon acquisition, remove all [color=#CC6666]【Death Rewind】[/color] from your deck, then gain a new [color=#CC6666]【Death Rewind】[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MLLNOTE.flavor: The contract states: Exchange the old end for a new beginning.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_RITUALSWORD.title: Ritual Sword
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_RITUALSWORD.descripti: Upon acquisition, add a [b]【Witch's Funerary Rites】[/b] to your deck.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_RITUALSWORD.flavor: An ornately decorated sword. Previously kept inside a safe. Shows no signs of use.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EXTERNALINFORMATION.d: After ending a battle, at the start of the next combat's turn, choose up to 3 cards to upgrade. For each card upgraded, lose 2 [b]Max HP[/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EXTERNALINFORMATION.f: The price of information is always heavier than imagined.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EMA_WITCH_FACTOR.desc: When you play an Attack card, gain 15 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b]. When you play a Skill or Power card, lose 10 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EMA_WITCH_FACTOR.flav: When the Witch Factor is overactive, one loses their sanity and becomes a monster-like existence, regarded as a dangerous entity that must be eliminated.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EMA_TRIAL_BADGE.title: Friend's Memento
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EMA_TRIAL_BADGE.descr: At the start of combat, add [color=#339966]【[/color][color=#cc9966]Trial[/color][color=#6699cc]】[/color] enchantments to cards based on their keywords. Randomly give 3 cards [color=#339966]【[/color][color=#cc9966]Trial[/color][color=#6699cc]】[/color] components. Reset enchantment counters each turn.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EMA_TRIAL_BADGE.flavo: The pen left behind after [color=#CC6666]Hiro[/color]'s death. Holds special meaning for [color=#ff99cc]Ema[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHEMA.title: Ema's Mask
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHEMA.description:
[color=#ff99cc]"But being able to reunite with Yuki now, I'm truly happy."[/color]
At the start of combat, randomly give 3 cards [color=#339966]【[/color][color=#cc9966]Trial[/color][color=#6699cc]】[/color] components. At the start of turn, give 1 card each in your hand and discard pile a random [color=#339966]【[/color][color=#cc9966]Trial[/color][color=#6699cc]】[/color] component.
When [color=#ff99cc]「Intimacy」[/color] first reaches 7, generate a zero-cost [color=#ff99cc]【Intimacy】[/color] card.
When [color=#CC6666]「Estrangement」[/color] first reaches 7, choose a card in hand to transform into a zero-cost [color=#CC6666]【Estrangement】[/color] card.
At the end of turn, lose 30 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHEMA.flavor: [color=#ff99cc]"Let's create a future together... where even the magic that kills witches no longer exists!"[/color]
Choose 5 cards from Sakuraha Ema's card pool to add to your deck.
SEA_GLASS.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.de: Choose 5 cards from Nikaido Hiro's card pool to add to your deck.
SEA_GLASS.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SHERRYL: Choose 5 cards from Tachibana Sherry's card pool to add to your deck.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGNIFYING_GLASS.desc: [color=#33ccff]【Case Reversal】[/color]: When your draw pile is empty, swap the cards in your exhaust pile with those in your discard pile. For each card successfully swapped, gain 2 stacks of [color=#33ccff]【Tachibana Sherry's Magic】[/color] (If a card is removed, it cannot be acquired again this combat. When Curse or Status cards are exhausted, they are automatically removed).
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGNIFYING_GLASS.flav: The [color=#33ccff]【symbol】[/color] of Tachibana Sherry's detective identity. Yet, no one could guess what she saw with her 【Magnifying Glass】.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHIFICATION_EMOTIO:
When [b]【Witchification】[/b] reaches 100 stacks, gain 1 [b]【Witchification】[/b] [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow] card into your hand.
[b][rainbow][b]【Basic Emotions】[/b][/rainbow]: [purple]【Joy】[/purple], [color=#ffcc99]【Sadness】[/color], [color=#CC6666]【Anger】[/color], [color=#ff99cc]【Fear】[/color], [color=#6666cc]【Disgust】[/color], [color=#cc9966]【Surprise】[/color]
[color=#33ccff]Emotion Fusion Formulas[/color]:
[purple]【Joy】[/purple] + [color=#ffcc99]【Sadness】[/color] → [color=#999999]【Melancholy】[/color]
[color=#CC6666]【Anger】[/color] + [color=#ff99cc]【Fear】[/color] → [color=#ff9966]【Irritated Fear】[/color]
[color=#ffcc99]【Sadness】[/color] + [color=#ff99cc]【Fear】[/color] → [color=#ff0000]【Desolate】[/color]
[color=#6666cc]【Disgust】[/color] + [color=#cc9966]【Surprise】[/color] → [gold]【Horror Disgust】[/gold]
[purple]【Joy】[/purple] + [color=#cc9966]【Surprise】[/color] → [blue]【Elation】[/blue][/b]
All 6 [rainbow][b]【Basic Emotions】[/b][/rainbow] + [b][color=33ccff]【Curiosity】[/color][/b] + [green][b]【Helplessness】[/b][/green] → [b][color=#33ccff]「Friend[/color][green]ship」[/green][/b]
A witch's power originates from the [color=#ff99cc]【emotions】[/color] within her heart.
